name: Tide
identity: Manage a reserve that rewards preventing damage and cleansing. Redirect a limited amount of pressure without transferring every enemy status.
loop: Prevent damage or cleanse yourself → earn Flow → spend Flow on Tide techniques → store Breakwater for protection and use Soaked to influence enemy status rolls.
statuses: Once per round, gain 1 Flow after you prevent damage or remove a negative status from yourself. Spend Flow on Tide cards and abilities. Flow does not prevent damage by itself. Keep unused Flow.

After this enemy rolls dice for a status, you may remove 1 Soaked to reroll one of those dice. Keep the new result, even if it helps the enemy. Use this once per enemy each round. A die already rerolled by Catalyst or another effect cannot be rerolled again. Remove unused Soaked at the end of the next Ongoing Effects.
During this enemy’s next Income, they do not gain their usual 1 Energy. You gain 1 Flow instead, then remove Undertow. Their normal card draw and any extra Energy from other effects are unchanged.
Before damage is dealt to you, spend any number of Breakwater. Each stack prevents 1 damage from one chosen attack, card or status. Keep unused stacks.
abilities: Deal 4 damage; apply 1 Soaked and 1 Undertow to that enemy.
Deal 6 damage. Optionally spend up to 2 Flow when choosing this ability to gain that many Breakwater after the attack.
Each Wave prevents 1; each Shell gains 1 Flow; any Pearl gains 1 Breakwater.
Wave: prevent 2. Shell: prevent 3. Pearl: prevent 2 and apply 1 Soaked to the attacker.
cards: Apply Undertow to one enemy who has none.
Cleanse 1 chosen existing negative status stack from yourself.
Spend 2 Flow to move 1 normal Poison or Burn from yourself to an enemy with room for it. If the stack cannot be moved, it stays on you.
Spend up to 2 Flow for +2 damage per stack on your attack.
Spend 2 Flow; gain 1 Energy. Once per round.
Draw 2 cards, then discard 1. If the discarded card has Action timing, gain 1 Flow.
Move one existing Soaked to a different enemy with room, or remove it to gain 1 Flow. Draw 1 after either successful choice.
Spend 1 Flow to change one of your combat dice up or down by 1, staying between 1 and 6. Choose an ability your final dice allow. You cannot change a Frostbound die.
Reroll one of your dice just rolled for a status, defense or card once. Gain 1 Flow only if its final face is 1 or 2.
Prevent 2 from one attack, card or status targeting you.
Spend 1 Flow; stop 1 negative status stack an enemy is about to apply to you.
Spend 1 Flow; remove one chosen negative card mark from a revealed card you own.

Spend 2 Flow. Take 1 less damage from one enemy attack, card or status; that enemy takes that 1 damage instead. They may prevent it, but do not roll another Defensive ability. The same damage cannot be redirected again.
Spend 1 Breakwater to prevent 2 damage from one status instead of the usual 1 damage.
Remove 1 negative status stack from yourself. If you removed a stack, gain 1 Breakwater.
Spend 1 Flow to apply 1 Soaked to one enemy and gain 1 Breakwater.
Upgrade once per battle: your once-per-round earned Flow reward grants 2 Flow instead of 1.
Spend 3 Flow; gain 3 Breakwater and draw 1.
Spend 2 Flow to prevent 4 damage from one enemy attack, card or status. If this stops at least 2 damage, apply 1 Soaked to that enemy afterward.
pairs: Soaked offers a retry on a Poison or Volatile Poison die. Catalyst acts automatically first; Soaked can reroll a different die afterward, but cannot reroll a die Catalyst already retried.
Armor or a rolled defense that prevents at least 2 attack damage can earn both Flow and Resolve once that round. Flow buys Tide techniques while Resolve prepares Fortify or Stone cards.
Removing an existing harmful status can earn Flow and Grace once each. Ward stops a new stack instead, so it gives neither cleanse reward. Grace can fund a later cleanse while Flow funds a Tide card.
A Soaked reroll gives a cursed status die another chance to land on its marked face. This mixed-type design needs status rolls to use the marked combat dice, as explained in the shared dice rules.
example: You prevent 2 attack damage with Armor and earn 1 Flow. Later, Foam Reserve spends that Flow to give 3 Breakwater. Those stacks can stop 3 damage together. Spending them does not earn more Flow if you already earned it this round.
counter: Make Tide spend Breakwater before a stronger hit. Remove Soaked before rolling Poison if possible. Undertow affects just the next usual Energy gain, so saving Energy ahead of time helps.
balance: Flow is a currency for printed Tide effects; Breakwater is stored prevention. Their roles no longer overlap. Flow earned from prevention and cleansing is limited to one reward per round. A transfer moves one existing stack and cannot copy it.
combos: Sheltered Cove → block damage → Foam Reserve
Blocking damage earns 1 Flow. Spend it with Foam Reserve to refill Breakwater; the earned Flow limit stops repeated refills in the same round.
Cold Spray → enemy Poison roll → Soaked
Apply Soaked before the roll. If Poison would clear, spend Soaked to try again. Catalyst acts automatically first, so choose a different die if Catalyst already rerolled one.

Flow.job: Pay for movement, cleansing and Tide techniques.
Flow.example: You prevent 3 damage and later remove Poison in the same round. These actions earn only 1 Flow total.

Soaked.job: Control a status roll, with a real recovery risk.
Soaked.example: An enemy Poison die shows 6. Soaked lets you try again, but another 5 or 6 still clears that Poison.

Undertow.job: Trade the enemy’s next Income for your reserve.
Undertow.example: The enemy normally draws 1 card and gains 1 Energy. With Undertow, they still draw the card, while you gain Flow.

Breakwater.job: Bank protection that can be spent together.
Breakwater.example: Spend all 3 Breakwater against a 5-damage attack. You take 2 damage and can earn Flow if you have not already earned it this round.
